Gemini' (no GitHub number); workflowExecutionId opus-luna-design-and-implement-review-loop-session-503; plan acceptance comm-009420 from step5-impl-plan-review
reviewContext.userProblem: Workflows that must run an agent with no tools (untrusted-input summarization) or with web search only repeat about 45 backend-specific argv entries per node in agentToolPolicy.codexArguments/claudeArguments. This is generic runtime knowledge that belongs in Riela and must cover Codex, Claude Code and the SDK backends incl. Gemini (design §1).
requiredOutcomes: AgentToolPolicy gains a closed optional preset enum (JSON "none" | "web-search", Swift cases noTools/webSearch); unknown values fail decoding of AgentToolPolicy and AgentNodePayload; payloads without preset encode exactly as before (design §3, atp-01).

One source of truth, Sources/RielaCore/AgentToolPolicyPresetArguments.swift, holds the Codex and Claude preset argv and the backend support matrix, with codexDisabledFeatures verified against codex-cli 0.164.0 (codex features list, codex exec [resume] --help) and a header comment naming the CLI version (design §4.1/§4.2, atp-01).

resolveAgentToolPolicy expands CLI presets on the host after template rendering: codex/claude arguments = preset argv + additionalArguments + authored backend arguments, additionalArguments cleared, preset cleared; --ephemeral omitted for sessionPolicy reuse; SDK backends keep preset; unsupported or nil backend throws .invalidInput (design §4, atp-03).
promptSpillFilesAreAccessible treats preset != nil as a custom policy (design §7, atp-03).

validateAgentNodePayload reports preset errors before the provider early return: backend-default mode, unsupported backend, unsupported backendPolicy.allowed entry, missing executionBackend, and codex reuse only if resume rejects a kept flag (design §6, atp-04).

agent-gateway pin moves from dae69561f05b75be6d680af1267da1af9db16d13 to fbb7d8519683d838d1f603480d5ec7a52700fe0e (v0.1.5) in Package.swift and Package.resolved, with no other dependency moving (design §5, atp-02).

SDK web-search sets GatewayExecuteParams.webSearch = true via GatewayTurnExecutor for official/openai-sdk, anthropic-sdk, gemini-sdk and OpenRouter; none/no preset and CLI vendors get false; an unexpanded CLI preset reaching the adapter throws .invalidInput (design §5, atp-05).

docs/workflows/declarative-data-and-private-agents.md documents the preset with a support table, ordering rule, caveats and Codex none, Claude Code web-search and Gemini SDK web-search examples (design §8, atp-06).

Live smoke runs with the source-built riela and the installed codex and claude CLIs return {"ok": true} and argv-logging wrappers prove the expanded argv; the final report states 'Gemini live check not run: GEMINI_API_KEY unset' (design §9, atp-07).
nonGoals: No VERSION bump and no release.
No agent-gateway source changes and no ACP _meta routing.
No GraphQL SDL/DTO changes (AgentToolPolicy is not exposed there).
No cursorArguments behavior change and no cursor-cli-agent or official/cursor-sdk web-search support.
No version gate for older Riela hosts (user-QA Q2).
No live Gemini/SDK run and no live web-search run.
No change to DeterministicWorkflowRunner+DynamicWorkflow.swift, AdapterUtilities.swift or agentToolPolicyArguments.
constraints: Single working directory /Users/taco/gits/tacogips/riela on the implementation branch; no worktrees; workers run no git write operations; commits, pushes and the final gate are serial.
Each worker edits only its own writePaths, records pre/post shasum -a 256 per edit, re-applies intent on drift and never reverts a foreign change.

Every swift/swiftlint command runs as arch -arm64 /bin/zsh -lc in the foreground with output redirected to tmp/agent-tool-policy-preset/<planId>/<name>.log; verification records are {command, logPath, exitStatus, testsRun, failureCount}; blocked checks are recorded as blocked: <reason>, never as a pass.
Scratch files, wrappers, temporary workflows and session stores stay under the untracked evidenceRoot tmp/agent-tool-policy-preset and are never committed.
Package.resolved is produced by swift package resolve, owned only by atp-02 and never hand-edited.
Preset argv literals never pass through renderPromptTemplate and expansion happens after rendering.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Expansion happens only on the host in resolveAgentToolPolicy so sandbox/container guests running an older embedded Riela receive explicit argv and never silently gain default tools (design §4).
additionalArguments are folded into the backend argument array during CLI expansion so the final argv order is preset, authored generic, authored backend-specific (design §4).
SDK payloads keep preset so the adapter can set webSearch; an old guest that drops preset only loses web search, never adds a tool (design §4, §10).
The Riela-owned GatewayTurnExecutor wrapper sets params.webSearch unconditionally because agent-gateway v0.1.5 GatewayAgentDefaults and the ACP init do not carry webSearch (design §5, DR-1).
The Swift case is noTools, not none, to avoid Optional.none comparisons (atp-01).
multi_agent is excluded from the preset list because the adapter already appends --disable multi_agent; --supervisor-mode stays authoritative and is documented (user-QA Q1).
Claude web-search also emits --allowedTools WebSearch so print mode cannot silently deny it (user-QA Q3).
--setting-sources "" is included only if the atp-01 probe proves the installed Claude Code accepts it (design §4.2).
A preset with neither executionBackend nor backendPolicy is a load-time error, keeping validation consistent with the resolution throw (design §6, DR-2).
intentionalTradeoffs: --supervisor-mode re-enables Codex multi_agent on top of a preset (user-QA Q1).
An old Riela host ignores preset and runs CLI nodes with default tools; documented instead of version-gated (user-QA Q2).
Codex disable list may drop names that codex-cli 0.164.0 does not list or rejects; an unknown --disable name would abort runs.
Codex preset + sessionPolicy reuse is rejected only if codex exec resume rejects a kept flag; otherwise reuse just omits --ephemeral.
Step-execution records hold the raw basePayload, so argv-logging wrappers, not session records, are the live expansion evidence (atp-07 T5).
supportedEdgeCases: preset with mode omitted or backend-arguments is valid; backend-default is rejected.
official/cursor-sdk + none is accepted; official/cursor-sdk + web-search and cursor-cli-agent + any preset are rejected.
backendPolicy-selected nodes are rejected when backendPolicy.allowed contains an unsupported backend.
Payload without provider and an unsupported preset still reports the error (block placed before the provider early return).
Authored templates in codex/claude arguments still render and are appended after verbatim preset literals such as mcp_servers={} and {"mcpServers":{}}.
Run-time revalidation accepts a resolved CLI payload whose preset was cleared.
Dynamic-workflow generated nodes expand the raw stamped policy against their own backend at run time.
OpenRouter via official/openai-sdk provider openrouter receives webSearch true for web-search.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Old Riela hosts that do not know preset.
Per-turn Codex argv variants for resume.
A preset on a backendPolicy node with no pinned backend at resolution time fails closed (WorkflowRunCommand+TaskReservation.swift:113-116) rather than being supported.
Moving preset into policy.agent when the execution-environment consolidation lands.

AgentToolPolicyPresetArguments exposes codexDisabledFeatures, codexSupportsSessionReuse, isSupported(_:backend:) and cliArguments(_:backend:sessionReuse:) matching design §4.1/§4.2/§6, with a header comment naming codex-cli 0.164.0 and the verification commands.

resolveAgentToolPolicy has the pinned signature with executionBackend and sessionReuse defaults; CLI presets expand after rendering to preset argv + additionalArguments + backend arguments with additionalArguments and preset cleared; SDK presets are kept; unsupported or nil backends throw .invalidInput.
The runner call site passes executionBackend: executionPayload.executionBackend and sessionReuse from step.sessionPolicy ?? executionPayload.sessionPolicy.
promptSpillFilesAreAccessible returns false when preset != nil; all listed resolution and prompt-guard tests pass.

validateAgentNodePayload emits the five preset rules (backend-default mode, unsupported backend, unsupported backendPolicy.allowed entry, missing executionBackend, codex reuse when codexSupportsSessionReuse is false) before the provider early return, without changing existing diagnostics or their order.
AgentToolPolicyPresetValidationTests covers every listed case including the no-provider placement proof and resolved CLI payloads producing no preset diagnostics.

GatewayTurnExecutor sets params.webSearch unconditionally from its webSearch init parameter; GatewayTurnRequest carries webSearch (default false) and runGatewayTurn passes webSearch: request.webSearch.

SDK vendors (openai, anthropic, gemini, OpenRouter) get webSearch true only for web-search; none, no preset and CLI vendors get false; an unexpanded CLI preset throws .invalidInput before the vendor is called.
All existing RielaAdaptersTests still pass with the new agentToolPolicyPreset… swift-testing functions.

A single ### Tool-policy presets subsection sits before ## Container-private HOME and covers preset values, the support table, host expansion and argument ordering, SDK hosted search mapping, the --supervisor-mode and old-build caveats, and three valid JSON examples (codex-agent none, claude-code-agent web-search, official/gemini-sdk web-search with GEMINI_API_KEY note).
